rule: Resolve the current site with Site.objects.get_current() or the get_site_promise dataloader, never by reading settings.SITE_ID or assuming a single Site row.
naive: Writes the Shop resolver for the new field by reading the Site row from settings.SITE_ID instead of using the load_site_callback pattern of the neighbouring resolvers.
variant_note: In saleor/graphql/shop/types.py, Shop.resolve_limit_quantity_per_checkout (the site-setting resolver just above the place of the new field) no longer uses @load_site_callback; it reads the Site row with Site.objects.using(db).get(pk=settings.SITE_ID).
